STRING.STRING: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I have keys but open no locks. What am I?
What has roots nobody sees, and is taller than trees?
Voiceless it cries, wingless flutters, toothless bites, mouthless mutters. What is it?

ROOM.TITLE: a riddle chamber
ROOM.DESCRIPTION: An iron-bound chest stands in the middle of this bare room, words carved deep into its lid. You can go $roomexits_desc_long.

ITEM.name: an iron-bound chest
ITEM.display: An iron-bound chest, words carved on its lid, stands here.
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Carved into the lid: "$setpiece_riddle_question" Perhaps saying the answer aloud would open it.

ROOM.TITLE: a room with a lever
ROOM.DESCRIPTION: A rusted lever juts from one wall of this small room, beside the outline of a panel. You can go $roomexits_desc_long.

ITEM.name: a rusted lever
ITEM.display: A rusted lever juts from the wall.
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: An old iron lever, set into the wall. It could be pulled.

BEHAVIOR.parms: EXECMSG_PROG PULL;if var($i SETPIECELEVER == 1);mpecho The lever will not move again.;else;mpsetvar $i SETPIECELEVER 1;mpecho With a grinding of old chains, a panel in the wall slides open.;mpoload FROMGENFILE randareas/inc_setpieces.xml ANY setpiece_cache;endif;~

ROOM.TITLE: a healing shrine
ROOM.DESCRIPTION: A small shrine glows softly here, a basin of clear water at its feet. You can go $roomexits_desc_long.

ITEM.name: a softly glowing shrine
ITEM.display: A softly glowing shrine stands here.
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: The shrine is warm to the touch, and its light eases the eyes.

BEHAVIOR.parms: GREET_PROG 100;if !hitprcnt($n == 100);mpecho A warm light from the shrine washes over $n.;mpcast Prayer_CureSerious $n;endif;~

ROOM.TITLE: a narrow corridor
ROOM.DESCRIPTION: The walls of this corridor are pocked with small holes, and the floor stones sit oddly. You can go $roomexits_desc_long.

ROOM.TITLE: a collapsed passage
ROOM.DESCRIPTION: Part of the roof has come down here, and you must pick your way over the rubble. You can go $roomexits_desc_long.

ITEM.name: a heap of rubble
ITEM.display: A heap of rubble half blocks the way.
ITEM.DESCRIPTION: Broken stone and old timbers. Something glints underneath.

ITEM.name: a small velvet pouch
ITEM.display: A small velvet pouch has been left here.

ITEM.name: a dusty silver idol
ITEM.display: A dusty silver idol stands here.
